question: Among all molecules that contain at least one triple bond, calculate the percentage of atoms that are either carbon or chlorine. Additionally, report how many of these triple-bonded molecules are labeled as carcinogenic.

prediction.sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
atoms_in_tbm AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001 AS atom_id, a.XCL_003 AS element
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS tbm ON a.XCL_002 = tbm.molecule_id
),
carc AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS carcinogenic_molecules
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS tbm ON m.XCL_010 = tbm.molecule_id
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN at.element IN ('c','cl') THEN at.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(at.atom_id) AS percentage_carbon_or_chlorine,
    cc.carcinogenic_molecules AS carcinogenic_molecule_count
FROM atoms_in_tbm AS at
CROSS JOIN carc AS cc;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
atoms_in_tbm AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_001 AS atom_id, a.XCL_003 AS element
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS tbm ON a.XCL_002 = tbm.molecule_id
),
carc AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010) AS carcinogenic_molecules
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS tbm ON m.XCL_010 = tbm.molecule_id
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN at.element IN ('c','cl') THEN at.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(at.atom_id) AS percentage_carbon_or_chlorine,
    cc.carcinogenic_molecules AS carcinogenic_molecule_count
FROM atoms_in_tbm AS at
CROSS JOIN carc AS cc;
